verdicts.why: Episode 1 already shows Murdock & McDuffie a year after Foggy's death, with Kirsten checking on Matt before Dex's sentencing.
In S1E9 Kirsten only remembers Foggy's unfiled motion to dismiss; Matt and Karen then find Foggy's files showing Red Hook is a free port.
In the finale Hogarth lures Trish to her home, Trish holds Kith hostage, and Hogarth leaves with her to help her escape the country.
Sinara serves and kills for Kasius from her first episode, S5E2 (she executes Reese). Removing her death avoids spoiling S5E9.
Hawkeye E3 shows the karate-class flashback with Kazi already Maya's second-in-command. The killing goes to its own Hawkeye#6 stage (item 365).
At Rockefeller Center (HE106) Kazi refuses to leave with Maya, attacks her with one of Barton's arrows, and she turns it on him and kills him.
Kate disarms and fights Kazi during the escape from the KB Toys hideout (HE103). At Rockefeller Center Kazi fights Clint and Maya, not Kate.
In S3E2 Kebo beats Werner until Werner stabs him, and Ward then invites Werner into his Hydra, so the episode leaves them on the same side.
In S3E6 Ward sends Kebo to kill Werner. Kebo tortures him at Malick's Lisbon penthouse and stabs him, then Bobbi Morse kills Kebo.
